facts.text: The hotel is at 1250 South Hayes Street, Arlington, Virginia.
facts.excerpt: 1250 South Hayes Street, Arlington, Virginia, USA, 22202

facts.text: The hotel is two Metro stops from downtown Washington, DC.
facts.excerpt: convenient location just two Metro stops from downtown Washington, DC, and DCA Airport

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Fashion Centre at Pentagon City and Pentagon Row.
facts.excerpt: steps from Fashion Centre at Pentagon City and Pentagon Row

facts.text: Santé is the hotel's Mediterranean-inspired restaurant on the lobby level, with seasonal ingredients and handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Located on our Lobby level, featuring Mediterranean-inspired dishes, seasonal ingredients, and handcrafted cocktails.

facts.text: Afternoon Tea includes a Teddy Bear Tea for children, with hot chocolate and a teddy bear to take home.
facts.excerpt: Our youngest tea goers can enjoy Teddy Bear Tea, with hot chocolate and a teddy bear to take home.

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the 18th floor, with views of the Pentagon and Washington, DC's monuments.
facts.excerpt: The 18th Floor Club Lounge offers breathtaking views of The Pentagon and sweeping Views over Washington, DC’s beautiful monuments.

facts.text: The Club Lounge offers five complimentary food and beverage presentations each day.
facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

facts.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club Level booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite status does not include it.
facts.excerpt: Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

facts.text: Guest room beds have Egyptian cotton linens.
facts.excerpt: feature beds with 400-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens

facts.text: Bathrooms have Italian marble and rainfall showerheads.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Italian marble baths with rainfall showerheads

facts.text: Monument View Rooms and Suites are offered, as are Premier Rooms on higher floors.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your view with Premier Rooms on higher floors, or with Monument View Rooms and Suites

facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has views of Arlington and Washington, D.C., a living and dining area, a bedroom and Club Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: magnificent views of Arlington and Washington, D.C., an expansive living and dining area, a spacious bedroom, and exclusive access to The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge

facts.text: The hotel offers the Ritz Kids program for children.
facts.excerpt: child-friendly hotel amenities, like the Ritz Kids program, offering fun, locally inspired entertainment

facts.text: The third-floor Fitness Center has a Peloton bike, steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: Located on the third floor, the Fitness Center features a Peloton bike, steam room, and sauna.

facts.text: Each evening, Virginia apples hand-dipped in a seasonal flavor are presented in the Lobby.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a presentation of Virginia apples, hand-dipped in a seasonal flavor with a topping of your choosing, each evening in the Lobby.

facts.text: The Club Lounge has an Enomatic wine system with a selection of rare wines chosen by a sommelier.
facts.excerpt: Our Enomatic Wine System features a hand-picked selection of exclusive and rare wines, curated from our sommelier.

facts.text: The hotel has no airport shuttle to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.
facts.excerpt: No, The Ritz-Carlton, Pentagon City does not have an airport shuttle to Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton, Pentagon City.

facts.text: Parking is valet only, with no self-parking.
